candidates.title: Cart-rule per-customer usage limit is enforced
candidates.preconditions: Cart rule with quantity_per_user=1; customer account; eligible cart; rule unused by that customer.
candidates.fixture: Redeem once, reset cart and attempt to redeem again as the same customer.

oracle.observable: First redemption is accepted; second is rejected or omitted and the order total reflects no second discount.

novelty.rationale: Baseline adds/edits products, customers and address data but has no mapped cart-rule redemption case.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline adds/edits products, customers and address data but has no mapped cart-rule redemption case.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: A different customer can redeem if global quantity remains available.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Order state, cart rule caches and generated customer account need deterministic reset.
candidates.uncertainty: Source stores per-customer quantity and checkValidity evaluates usage; UI wording and order timing remain unverified.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Cart-rule per-customer usage limit is enforced.

candidates.title: Carrier eligibility follows configured price/weight range
candidates.preconditions: Two carriers with disjoint price or weight ranges and an order cart on either side of the boundary.
candidates.fixture: Proceed to carrier selection with cart value/weight below, at and above configured ranges.

oracle.observable: The available-carrier calculation returns only carriers with a matching price/weight range when range_behavior requests deactivation; with fallback behavior enabled, the carrier remains eligible and the configured maximum-range price path applies.

novelty.rationale: Baseline address/category/product cases do not check shipping carrier selection or range boundaries.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline address/category/product cases do not check shipping carrier selection or range boundaries.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Switch from price-based to weight-based range and ensure the other basis does not determine eligibility.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Carrier module/config and tax inclusion influence calculated values.
candidates.uncertainty: Pinned getCarriersForOrder and getAvailableCarrierList implement the eligibility and range/fallback logic. The checkout template/API presentation and zone/shop configuration effects still require runtime validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Carrier eligibility follows configured price/weight range.

candidates.title: Successful payment creates one order and applies stock synchronization
candidates.preconditions: One available product, known initial stock, valid address and deterministic test payment module.
candidates.fixture: Complete checkout once; reload order confirmation and product stock.

oracle.observable: Exactly one order/history entry exists and stock quantity changes according to configured stock-dependency mode.

novelty.rationale: Baseline out-of-stock validity concerns product state but does not exercise payment-to-order transition or stock delta.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline out-of-stock validity concerns product state but does not exercise payment-to-order transition or stock delta.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Force payment validation failure and verify no completed order/stock decrement is falsely recorded.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Payment module and stock dependency settings must be fixed; avoid real payment provider.
candidates.uncertainty: Source validates orders, writes order details/history and conditionally synchronizes stock; payment result semantics need test module.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Successful payment creates one order and applies stock synchronization.

candidates.title: Available quantity update stays consistent with product/combination stock
candidates.preconditions: Product with one default combination and a second combination; initial quantities recorded; stock sharing mode known.
candidates.fixture: Update available quantity for each combination through admin and reload product availability.

oracle.observable: Each combination retains its own expected quantity unless stock sharing is enabled; storefront availability follows the configured quantity.

novelty.rationale: Baseline adds products and tests out-of-stock validity but does not compare updates across combinations.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline adds products and tests out-of-stock validity but does not compare updates across combinations.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Attempt a negative/non-integer quantity and verify validation rejects it.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Product-combination and shop stock-sharing settings complicate reset and oracle.
candidates.uncertainty: Source models quantity and synchronization; combination/shop-specific semantics need configuration pinning.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Available quantity update stays consistent with product/combination stock.
